53: However, with regard to an ailonit - granted that he is allowed to remain married to her; however, she does not drink, for the following reason: we require that she be able to become pregnant. A  barren women [is unable to become pregnant] due to a wound, and an elderly woman was formerly able to become pregnant. An ailonit, however, was already thus afflicted when in her mother's womb, and therefore is not considered fit [to "bear seed"].
